corpus: My homelab is a Mac Mini that I've turned into a personal infrastructure platform powering my entire household with a *Docker-based stack* of self-hosted services covering everything from notification infrastructure to home automation. I run **local LLMs**, set up AI-powered workflows and automations, and integrate cutting-edge AI tooling in ways that quietly sharpen how I think about AI in my professional work too. Outside of software, I run two **Bambu Lab P1S** 3D printers, and they shape the way I think about *robotics projects*.

I'm a **full stack software engineer** with a *B.S. in Computer Science* from the **University of Missouri–Kansas City**, I graduated *Cum Laude*, with a focus in **AI**. Starting in college for nearly three years I worked as a software engineer for a venture capital group where I collaborated with a team of mathematicians to build probabilistic modeling software. This was work that sat right at the intersection of applied mathematics and software engineering.

Today I work at **Herzog Technologies** building enterprise software code-first applications, including *data pipelines*, *database integrations*, and workflows that operate under serious **reliability requirements**. When the problem calls for it, I bring **AI** into the stack strategically. I care about *clean code*, systems built to last, and shipping work that holds up in the real world. I consider myself a **lifelong learner**, the field moves fast and I move with it. I do my best to hold my work to a high standard and I'm always looking for ways to raise that bar.

I'm currently developing apps targeting **iOS and Android**, building things that work everywhere without compromise. I actively explore **AI agents** and apply them across my development process, the products I build, and my personal infrastructure. On the physical side, *robotics* and *3D printing* are increasingly intersecting with longer term projects I'm actively researching and building toward, software that tackles real problems in **aerodynamics** and **fluid dynamics**, spanning *simulation* and *physical prototyping*. I'm passionate about software that works alongside robotics and aerodynamics. At the end of the day, I'm just always trying to learn something new.
